customer: Leasing my hatchback through Crescent Motor Credit. Can Northwind buy out the lease?
agent: Thanks for reaching out! Based on our article "Which leasing companies allow third-party buyouts," Crescent Motor Credit doesn't allow us to buy out your lease directly. You can buy the car out yourself first and then sell it to us, or return it at the end of the lease. Our article "Selling vs. turning in at lease end" covers both options if you'd like to compare.
